entities.name: Jaguar Tooth
entities.evidence: Jaguar Tooth is non-persistent malware that targets Cisco IOS routers. Capability includes automated device information collection that is exfiltrated over TFTP and unauthenticated backdoor access.

entities.evidence: The vulnerability occurs within k_alpsRemPeerConnEntry_get (0x60E72178), part of AirLine

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
entities.evidence: Uppercasing is disabled using multiple ROP gadgets, the main Jaguar Tooth payload is then copied into memory.
